stories.title: When Zero Was Born in India
stories.description: An ancient Indian guru explains how zero was conceived in India and transformed human understanding.

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of an ancient Indian guru (around 65–70 years old) walking slowly and directly toward the camera along a stone corridor inspired by Nalanda University. Male, long white and grey beard, deeply lined face, serene and wise eyes, high forehead, calm spiritual authority. Wearing simple saffron and off-white robes, rudraksha beads around the neck, holding palm-leaf manuscripts. He is clearly speaking while walking, lips articulating speech, mouth and jaw moving naturally, eyes engaging directly with the camera. Front-facing camera only. Character always faces directly toward the camera. Chest and face square to the camera at all times. No side view. No profile view. No over-the-shoulder angle.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow reverent forward walk, camera tracking backward on straight axis, no rotation, no orbit, continuous speaking mouth and jaw movement, gentle head nods, stable framing
scenes.narration: We count one, two, three. But once, the world did not know how to count nothing.

scenes.visual_prompt: Same ancient Indian guru, still walking directly toward the camera. The stone corridor shows faint chalk marks of numbers carved into the walls. He continues speaking clearly with calm authority. Front-facing camera only. Character always faces directly toward the camera. Chest and face square to the camera at all times. No side or angled views.
scenes.motion_prompt: steady slow forward walk, camera tracking backward on straight axis, continuous speaking mouth movement, subtle eyebrow emphasis, stable framing
scenes.narration: For a long time, there was no name for nothing. Without it, great calculations were impossible.

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of the same guru walking directly toward the camera in an open stone courtyard with pillars. Young disciples study quietly in the background. The guru speaks with certainty, lips articulating each word clearly. Front-facing camera only. No side view or profile.
scenes.motion_prompt: dignified forward walk, subtle hand emphasis while speaking, camera tracking backward on straight axis, gentle background motion, stable framing
scenes.narration: In India, scholars gave nothing a form. Zero was not emptiness anymore. It became a number with meaning and rules.

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of the guru beneath a stone archway carved with ancient symbols and maps. He slowly comes to rest, facing the camera, speaking peacefully with steady eye contact. Front-facing camera only. Chest and face square to the camera at all times.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow walk easing into stillness while facing camera, continuous mouth movement, gentle head nods, camera settles smoothly on straight axis, stable framing
scenes.narration: From this idea came powerful mathematics, astronomy, and science. The modern world stands on this single discovery.
